content:
Join NightBet Casino and step into a world of exciting casino entertainment! Discover new slots, enjoy thrilling moments with live dealers and experience the atmosphere of a real casino. At NightBet, we've brought together engaging games, exciting bonuses and weekly prize draws to make every visit feel fresh. Choose your favourites, play at your own pace and enjoy every moment!

Weekly Raffle

Join our Weekly Raffle for a chance to win a share of the weekly prize pool! At NightBet, we hold regular prize draws where every deposit earns you one Raffle Ticket. The more tickets you collect, the more chances you have to win. It's another way to add a little extra excitement to your favourite casino games.

Taking part is easy. Simply click the Join Weekly Raffle button and make deposits to collect tickets for the draw. Each ticket gives you a chance to claim a share of the prize pool, with new prizes up for grabs every week. Keep an eye on upcoming draws at NightBet Casino and see what surprises might come your way!

New Games

Love discovering new slots? At NightBet Casino, we're constantly expanding our game collection with fresh releases, bringing you new themes, exciting mechanics and bonus features to explore. Head to our New Games section to discover the latest additions, from classic fruit machines to modern slots packed with extra rounds and entertaining features.

Try Thor's Thunder Strike by Spinomenal, inspired by Norse mythology, or set off on an adventure in 3 Aztec Spells. If you enjoy colourful fruit slots, take a spin on 81 Fruits Fire Blaze by Retro Gaming. You can also explore BGaming releases such as Red Hot Chilli Chickens and Wincent Wolf. For something different, check out Magical Piñata Hold & Hit 3x3 and Zeus Powerstorm Bonus Flash 3x3, both offering exciting bonus mechanics.

Our latest additions cover plenty of different playing styles. Mega Mummy Hold & Hit 3x3 combines an Ancient Egyptian theme with Hold & Hit mechanics, while Book of Hidden Tombs takes you on a journey through ancient mysteries. We regularly refresh the NightBet game collection, making it easy to switch between familiar favourites and brand-new releases.

Live Casino

Fancy experiencing the atmosphere of a real casino? Step into the NightBet Casino live dealer section, where card games and roulette come to life with professional dealers. Watch the action unfold in real time, place your bets and follow every result straight from your screen.

You'll find different versions of roulette, blackjack and baccarat from Evolution and Pragmatic Play. Choose traditional tables with familiar rules or explore special editions with additional features. Lightning Storm by Evolution brings game-show excitement into the mix, while Mega Roulette and Fortune Roulette by Pragmatic Play add fresh twists to the classic roulette experience.

Looking for something a little different? Discover Crazy Time, Mega Wheel or Sweet Bonanza Candyland. These games combine live presenters, interactive bonus rounds and engaging gameplay. If you prefer traditional card games, you can always take a seat at our blackjack and baccarat tables for a more classic casino experience.

Game Providers

At NightBet Casino, we bring together games from a variety of developers, giving you plenty of ways to enjoy your favourite casino entertainment. From traditional slots with straightforward gameplay to modern releases featuring creative bonus mechanics, every studio brings something different to our collection.

Our game providers include BGaming, Spinomenal, Belatra Games, Caleta Gaming, Hacksaw Gaming, Novomatic, PG Soft, OneTouch and 3 Oaks Gaming. Their games feature different themes, visual styles and approaches to gameplay. Spinomenal creates adventure-themed slots inspired by mythology, while BGaming combines colourful designs with modern mechanics. Hacksaw Gaming is known for dynamic slots with unusual bonus features, whereas Novomatic brings the familiar charm of traditional fruit machines.

If you enjoy games with distinctive visuals, explore releases from PG Soft and Caleta Gaming. Belatra Games and 3 Oaks Gaming add more themed slots to the collection, while OneTouch focuses on games designed for convenient mobile play. We regularly introduce new releases at NightBet, so there's always something different to discover alongside your established favourites.

Bonuses and Promotions

Start your journey at NightBet Casino with our welcome package, covering your first four deposits. Each deposit unlocks a separate bonus offer, combining extra funds with Free Spins on selected slots.

  • First deposit: 100% bonus up to €1,000 and 50 Free Spins on Gold of Minos.

  • Second deposit: 75% bonus up to €1,000 and 30 Free Spins on Olympus TRUEWAYS.

  • Third deposit: 100% bonus up to €1,000 and 50 Free Spins on Elvis Frog TRUEWAYS.

  • Fourth deposit: 125% bonus up to €1,000 and 100 Free Spins on Wild Tiger 2.

There's more to explore beyond our welcome rewards. With Weekly Surprise, make more than four deposits in a week to receive a Mystery Bonus. We also have a cashback offer linked to your gaming activity, while our 50% Bonus promotion lets you claim up to €2,000 in additional bonus funds with a qualifying deposit.

Our special promotions also include Trick or Treat! Contact our customer support team to claim a €5 Free Bet as part of this offer. Available promotions at NightBet may change, so you'll always find the latest deals and their conditions in our bonuses section.

Only one bonus can be active at a time. Any additional rewards you've claimed will remain in the queue, and deposit bonuses cannot be combined. Certain Free Spins offers may require a promo code, so check the details of your chosen promotion before activating it.

Payments and Withdrawals

Top up your account using your preferred payment method and manage your funds through the NightBet Casino cashier. We support traditional banking options, e-wallets and cryptocurrencies, giving you a variety of ways to handle your transactions.

For card payments, you can use Visa or Mastercard, while Apple Pay and Google Pay provide additional digital payment options. We also support Skrill, Neteller, Revolut and Wise. Bank transfers are available through SEPA and other banking services, with regional payment methods including iDEAL, Interac, EPS, Blik and MB Way.

If you prefer cryptocurrencies, our cashier supports Bitcoin, Ethereum, Tether US, USD Coin, Litecoin, Solana and other digital assets. This gives you the flexibility to choose between familiar banking methods and cryptocurrency transactions.

To withdraw your funds from NightBet Casino, visit the cashier and select an available withdrawal method. We process withdrawal requests in line with our internal procedures and the requirements of the relevant payment providers. Bank transfers and card transactions are also subject to processing by financial institutions. Account and transaction checks may be carried out before a withdrawal is approved.

To verify your identity, we may ask you to provide photographic identification and proof of address. These checks help us protect your account and ensure that financial transactions are handled securely.

Customer Support

Have a question about a game, bonus or account transaction? The NightBet Casino customer support team is here to help you find the answers. We aim to make getting assistance straightforward, so you can resolve any questions and get back to enjoying your favourite games.

You can reach us through Live Chat or email. Our NightBet support team can assist with account access, bonus conditions, payments and document verification. If we need any additional information to resolve your enquiry, we'll explain what to do next.

We're committed to promoting a comfortable and responsible gaming experience. Treat casino games as entertainment, set personal spending limits and take regular breaks whenever you need them.

mainEntity.name: Can I create multiple accounts at NightBet Casino?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. We allow only one account per player. Creating additional accounts to claim bonuses more than once is prohibited and may result in the cancellation of bonus funds and winnings obtained in breach of our rules.

mainEntity.name: Can I cancel an activated bonus?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. If you decide not to continue with a deposit bonus, you can cancel it instead of completing its requirements. Any bonus funds associated with that offer will be forfeited.

mainEntity.name: How long do Free Spins remain active?

acceptedAnswer.text: Free Spins bonuses are generally valid for 24 hours after being received, unless the terms of a particular promotion state otherwise. Unused rewards may expire once their validity period ends.

mainEntity.name: Can I use bonus funds and Free Spins at the same time?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Bonus funds and Free Spins cannot be used simultaneously. Each activated reward has its own conditions, and any additional bonuses remain in the queue until they become available.

mainEntity.name: What documents might I need for identity verification?

acceptedAnswer.text: We may request a passport, national identity card or driving licence featuring your photograph. To confirm your residential address, we may also require a utility bill issued within the last three months.

mainEntity.name: Can I make payments in different currencies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, NightBet Casino supports multiple currencies for transactions. The available options depend on your selected payment method. You can view the supported currencies directly in the cashier.
